problem: ML/DJW often emits too-short syllable boxes that miss IoU≥0.5 against human word tags (tea|cher class).
whatWhisperWordTimestampsAre: Per-word start/end times from faster-whisper with word_timestamps=True, aligned from padded tag-cluster windows to absolute session time.
whyTheyCouldHelp: Independent word-boundary proposals that could replace or merge syllable over-splits, even when ASR spelling is wrong.

recommendation.verdict: Need DJW merge-back — Whisper not enough alone
recommendation.rationale: Overlap coverage is high (94.4%), but word-box IoU≥0.5 is only 25.7% — worse than DJW/fresh candidates on the same problem (~50–57% from iou_sweep; archival St_87 48.6%). Text match is 8.9%, and the dominant error mode is word_split (40.8%): Whisper itself over-fragments. Prioritize acoustic DJW merge-back; treat Whisper timestamps as an optional weak prior only where a single token already IoU-aligns.
